items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not speak in the provided context. The interviewer mentions 'Zooty and Marge' played together in Charlie Creath's band. The interviewee is not stated to have interacted with Marge.

ctx.x: Clayton Bottoms and there's a brickyard there. People work in the brickyards there. But, up top of the hill there are about three or four musical spots there and one our spot a lot of nice things used to happen and fellows who were prominent in those days and doing different things, like wrestlers, them kind of cats, just stop in and say hello (?.) But, there was one guy I'll never forget.
Well, where was Dago Hill that Zooty and Marge were talking about?

That's in St. Louis. Now you must remember, Zooty and Marge would be around 5 or 10 years older at least. ... See, Zooty and Marge played together in Charlie Creath's band and Charlie Creath was a professional trumpet player where I'm trying to get so it makes a difference. I don't know what the age... I thought they were wonderful. I still think they're wonderful. Zoot and Marge and Charlie, they're something else. Dago Hill is down the road a piece. We used to go over to St. Louis. I can say this out. I was…
